newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 21.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 21.

text.p: Here are the main headlines on Latvia's state radio at noon on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The U.S. and Russian presidents are in talks in Helsinki. On starting the talks, both were optimistic on reaching agreement.
- Human rights activists staged a protest in front of the hotel where U.S. President Bil Clinton is staying.
- Latvian and Russian border delimitation talks continue today and it is not yet known whether an agreement will be ready to initial today.
